meta.angle: Anti-Bilancia - smettere di pesarsi (pain v4 + brand v2)
meta.pain-targeted: "Hai smesso di salire perche sai cosa direbbe" - evitamento bilancia

image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference) standing in a clean modern bathroom, looking at camera with a direct strong expression. With one hand she points down toward an old analog bathroom scale on the floor, with the other hand she does a clear "STOP" gesture (palm out toward viewer). The scale on the floor visibly has a thin dust layer or a towel half-covering it - clearly abandoned. Her expression: coach assertive but warm, "let me tell you something" energy, slight smile.
She wears practical home clothes (athletic top + leggings or simple). Bright clean modern Italian bathroom, white tiles, soft natural daylight from window, NEUTRAL white-balanced color (NOT warm golden Mediterranean grading).
CRITICAL STYLE: COACH POWER MOMENT, clean direct photography, NOT cinematic still life. NOT vintage Wim Wenders quiet. Real Italian woman 45, real body, natural skin. The "STOP" gesture toward camera is the visual hero, the abandoned scale is the supporting detail.
Composition: Elena center-frame from chest up, hand-stop visible toward viewer, scale visible at bottom of frame (lower-third), plenty of clean negative space top for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic still life, Wim Wenders quiet, vintage bathroom, golden hour, contemplative quiet moment, woman standing on scale, weight number visible, body shaming, harsh fluorescent, sad pose, fashion editorial

design-brief.instructions: Layout brand WINNER v5 con foto Elena.
